# ShopBot Index

> ShopBot Index is an independent weekly index of what online stores tell AI shopping agents. Every Monday it checks 2854 retailers and stores (3294 websites): Shopify stores, big retailers and other retailers & marketplaces. The headline measure is whether each one publishes a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read, at /.well-known/ucp.

Latest crawl: 2026-11-09. In ShopBot Index's crawl of 9 November 2026, 951 of the 2225 retailers and stores we could check publish a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read (42.7%). By segment: Shopify stores 841 of 1042 (80.7%), big retailers 16 of 255 (6.3%) and other retailers & marketplaces 94 of 928 (10.1%). We couldn't check 629 of the 2854 we track (blocked or unreachable), so they aren't counted, and we re-check every store each Monday.

## AI agent readiness

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, these are the agent-readiness signals the crawl records. Each figure counts stores, and only stores we could check for that signal. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the check. Stores we couldn't check are left out. A refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

- UCP profile: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 951 of 2,225 stores we could check publish a UCP profile (42.7%). https://shopbotindex.com/#summary
- ACP: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1 of 1,270 stores we could check publishes an Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) discovery file (0.1%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/acp/
- llms.txt: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 216 of 1,305 stores we could check publish an llms.txt file (16.6%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/llms-txt/
- AGENTS.md: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 31 of 1,248 stores we could check publish an AGENTS.md file (2.5%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/agents-md/
- AI catalog: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 3 of 1,263 stores we could check publish an AI catalog (0.2%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/ai-catalog/
- MCP endpoint: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 945 of 2,466 stores we could check name an MCP endpoint in their UCP profile (38.3%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/mcp/
- MCP tools list: Only 8 endpoints returned a tools list when queried (924 returned HTTP 422, 11 refused). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/mcp/#tools
- AI crawler rules: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 279 of 2,075 stores we could check have robots.txt rules that name an AI crawler (13.4%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/ai-bots-robots/
- Wildcard robots.txt block: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 7 of 2,075 stores we could check have a wildcard robots.txt rule that disallows the whole site (0.3%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/ai-bots-robots/#wildcard
- Content-Signal: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 75 of 2,075 stores we could check publish a Content-Signal line in robots.txt (3.6%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/ai-bots-robots/#content-signal
- Bot protection: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1,181 of 2,429 stores we could check had bot protection that refused our crawler (48.6%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/bot-protection/
- Product data: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 161 of 271 stores we could check have schema.org Product markup on a product page we fetched (59.4%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/product-data/
- Poppy: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1 of 1,335 stores we could check publishes a valid Poppy file (0.1%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/agent-cards/#poppy
- A2A agent card: In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 0 of 1,312 stores we could check publish a valid A2A agent card (0.0%). https://shopbotindex.com/signals/agent-cards/#a2a

How to read the results:
- "UCP profile found": the store publishes a Universal Commerce Protocol profile at /.well-known/ucp and lists what it supports. A UCP profile isn't proof that AI agents can shop at a store.
- "No UCP profile found": we found no profile. It does not mean AI agents can't shop there.
- "Couldn't check": the site refused or failed our requests; excluded from all rates.
- Shares are shares of our list, not of all online stores. Every figure comes from our own crawl.

- [What is a UCP profile](https://shopbotindex.com/guides/what-is-a-ucp-profile/): What a /.well-known/ucp profile is for AI shopping agents, and whether it means an agent can check out.
- [Check your store](https://shopbotindex.com/check.html): How to check whether an online store publishes a UCP profile: fetch /.well-known/ucp, or look the domain up in this crawl.

- [Guides](https://shopbotindex.com/guides/): Short guides on how to read ShopBot Index results.
- [What a published UCP profile proves](https://shopbotindex.com/guides/what-a-ucp-profile-proves/): What a published UCP profile tells you, why an unchecked store stays unknown, and how to read the index without overstating a result.

- [AI assistants](https://shopbotindex.com/assistants.html): Which AI assistants name which retailers, from the companies' own announcements, with links.

## Data

- One page per store: https://shopbotindex.com/store/<name>.html (all listed in https://shopbotindex.com/sitemap.xml)
- Store lookup used by "Check your store": https://shopbotindex.com/stores.json (domain -> [page slug, store name, result: ucp | no_ucp | couldnt_check, store id])
- Updated every Monday after the crawl. Full text of the key facts and methodology: https://shopbotindex.com/llms-full.txt

## FAQ

- **What is a UCP profile?** A Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile is a JSON file a store publishes at `/.well-known/ucp`: the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read. It lists the protocol version, services, capabilities (for example checkout, cart or catalog search) and payment handlers. [How we check it](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html).
- **How many online stores publish a UCP profile?** In our crawl of 9 November 2026, 951 of the 2225 retailers and stores we could check (42.7%). By segment: Shopify stores 841 of 1042 (80.7%), big retailers 16 of 255 (6.3%) and other retailers & marketplaces 94 of 928 (10.1%). These are shares of our list of 2854, not of all online stores.
- **Which big retailers publish a UCP profile?** 16 in the crawl of 9 November 2026: American Eagle Outfitters, Asprey, Boozt, Debenhams PLC, FAO Schwarz, Farfetch, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Hamleys, IKEA, Mexx, On AG, Pepco, Poundland, Quiksilver, The Body Shop and Zellers. That is 16 of the 255 big retailers we could check. [See all big retailers](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/big.html).
- **What does it mean if a store has no UCP profile?** Only that we found no profile at `/.well-known/ucp`. Some agent shopping runs through a normal web browser or through channels we can't see from outside, such as product feeds shared privately with AI assistants. Equally, a UCP profile isn't proof that AI agents can shop at a store.
- **How often is ShopBot Index updated?** Every week. The crawl runs on Mondays; the latest was on 9 November 2026 and the next is due on 16 November 2026. [See what changed](https://shopbotindex.com/changes.html).
- **How can I check my own store?** Type its domain into [Check your store](https://shopbotindex.com/check.html). It looks the domain up in our latest crawl. If the store isn't in the index yet, email [hello@shopbotindex.com](mailto:hello@shopbotindex.com) and we'll include it in a future crawl.
- **What did the 9 November 2026 crawl record for each agent-readiness signal?** In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, these are the agent-readiness signals the crawl records. Each figure counts stores, and only stores we could check for that signal. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the check. Stores we couldn't check are left out. A refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ## Methodology

- **What does ShopBot Index check on each website?** It reads `/robots.txt` first, then fetches `/.well-known/ucp`, where the UCP specification says a business publishes its profile. It also records supporting signals: an MCP endpoint named in the UCP profile, AI-agent rules in robots.txt, `/llms.txt` or `/agents.md`, and schema.org Product markup on one product page. [Details](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html#signals).
- **Why are some stores marked "couldn't check"?** Every one of their websites refused our request (401/403/429), timed out, failed TLS or DNS, or disallowed the path in robots.txt. We never try to get around that. These stores are shown separately and left out of adoption rates: 629 of 2854 in the crawl of 9 November 2026.
- **Which stores are tracked?** Three segments, side by side: Shopify stores (1330), Big retailers (350) and Other retailers & marketplaces (1174). They come from Wikipedia and Wikidata lists and public lists of Shopify stores. This is not a random sample of all stores, so shares are shares of our list.
- **How many requests does the crawler send?** Usually 10 to 14 per website per week, and never more than 18, one at a time per website, with robots.txt respected for every URL. [How we fetch](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html#crawler).
- **How can a website opt out?** Disallow `/` (or just the paths we read) for `ShopBotIndexBot` in robots.txt, or email [hello@shopbotindex.com](mailto:hello@shopbotindex.com).
- **Does ShopBot Index test purchases?** No. We don't test purchases, and we don't score or rank how well a store works with any assistant.

## Contact

hello@shopbotindex.com · https://x.com/ShopBotIndex


## Results by segment (crawl of 2026-11-09)

- Shopify stores (Stores from public lists of Shopify stores.): 1330 tracked, 841 UCP profile found, 201 no UCP profile found, 288 couldn't check; 841 of 1042 checked (80.7%).
- Big retailers (Retailers on Wikipedia's List of largest retail companies, or with Wikipedia articles in 10+ languages.): 350 tracked, 16 UCP profile found, 239 no UCP profile found, 95 couldn't check; 16 of 255 checked (6.3%).
- Other retailers & marketplaces (Other retail chains, department stores, supermarkets, hypermarkets and online marketplaces listed on Wikipedia or Wikidata.): 1174 tracked, 94 UCP profile found, 834 no UCP profile found, 246 couldn't check; 94 of 928 checked (10.1%).
